ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) with high-intensity (white/light grey) regions localized to the distal-superior quadrants; approximate ratio of 4:1 low-to-high intensity.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white patches are concentrated in the upper outer lobes. The left lobe contains a large irregular vertical patch with internal dark occlusions. The right lobe contains a diagonal high-intensity band. Low-intensity stippling (small white spots) is distributed across the central and lower ventral surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency macro-serrations present across the entire trailing edge. The left lobe exhibits more pronounced, jagged peaks compared to the right lobe which has a smoother, lower-amplitude serration profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-lateral concave curves originating at the median notch and extending to sharp, upward-tapering tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of roughly circular, high-contrast white pixel groups (barnacles) located on the distal tips of both the left and right lobes, with secondary clusters along the lower lateral margins.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A distinct horizontal dark linear disruption is visible on the upper left white patch. Multiple fine, dark, unaligned linear marks are visible within the light pigmentation of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable jagged irregular contour on the superior edge of the left lobe suggesting minor tissue loss; significant barnacle colonization on both fluke tips.
